review.source_gold_method: Manually selected physical source constructs and byte/line boundaries; stdlib byte operations compute keys. No fixture parser or producer output.

range_convention.lines: one-based; end_line contains final included byte
range_convention.columns: zero-based UTF-8 byte columns; end position separately names end_exclusive_line
range_convention.methods: def token through final included body byte, excluding decorators/trailing whitespace, matching current native add_definition source
range_convention.configuration_targets: raw literal code field text, explicitly configuration_value; never a callable definition

inventory_hashing.scope: all baseline synthetic, selected corpus, individual mutation result and exact restore inventory hashes
inventory_hashing.path: exact relative POSIX path string from the listed inventory; no normalization, prefixing, absolute path or namespace; all frozen paths are ASCII and contain no JSON-escaping characters
inventory_hashing.row: [path, lowercase 64-character SHA-256 of exact file bytes, file byte length as a base-10 JSON integer]
inventory_hashing.ordering: sort rows ascending by the path UTF-8 bytes, without case folding; all frozen paths are unique ASCII so this equals ordinal string ordering
inventory_hashing.serialization: one JSON array of rows, each row a JSON array; quote path and hash strings; separate elements/rows using one comma; no spaces/indentation; no object fields; no trailing comma
inventory_hashing.encoding_and_terminator: UTF-8 bytes, no BOM and no final newline; serialize the JSON array, not the enclosing input artifact or its escaped JSON string representation
inventory_hashing.hash: SHA-256 of those canonical UTF-8 bytes, encoded as lowercase hexadecimal
inventory_hashing.independent_reproduction: Recompute each file SHA/length; sort and construct the defined rows/bytes; or decode canonical_inventory_utf8 from this input as a JSON string and UTF-8 encode its value unchanged, verifying serialized_bytes and sha256. Starting/restore commitment references resolve to synthetic_baseline.

source_admission.production_boundary: Trusted caller/config explicitly admits dependency/root and per-source consumer/service/configuration ownership; oracle case IDs, expected targets and gold hashes/ranges never appear in production context. Actual inventory digests establish source freshness only. A module named odoo is insufficient. Synthetic identity is test-only.
source_admission.selection: Within one explicitly admitted provider root, each canonical module has exactly stem.py and stem/__init__.py alternatives, selected independently of exports. Zero/multiple/partial candidates, conditional imports, duplicate exports and shadowing produce zero-target boundaries with positive/negative lookup receipts. Root namespace absence is permitted only as explicitly declared pinned Odoo source-root form, not general packaging or runtime sys.path support.
source_admission.namespace_guard: complete parent initializer if present, no explicit namespace segment rebinding; otherwise an explicit namespace-source-root identity and complete canonical inventory witness. odoo/init.py is bootstrap source, not an initializer to execute.
source_admission.ordinary_resolution: Registration/declaration identity only, within existing shared resolver and syntax context. Ordinary absolute Python import/reexport/call behavior remains unchanged; no runtime/lexical promotion.

rules.supported: sole canonical http.route decorator, literal string or literal string list/tuple, direct physically owned method; physical def target excludes decorators
rules.unknown: computed/omitted/inherited route, shadowed API, other decorators, partial or ambiguous imports; controller inheritance/active routing always unqualified

rules.supported: direct canonical models.Model base, one unconditional literal primary source label (_name, or _inherit string/list when _name is absent) and one locally owned method; no decorator or sole canonical bare api.model annotation. Additional literal _inherit on a class with _name is source metadata only, never a registry join
rules.unknown: computed primary labels/bases, duplicate primary metadata/method declarations, other decorators, transitive class inference; no _inherit/_inherits registry join or env/recordset/super target resolution

rules.supported: explicit manifest-owned/trusted-admitted XML configuration, literal record model=ir.cron/id, one literal state=code, one plain code field; target is the physical configuration-value span, not a callable
rules.unknown: eval/computed/missing/duplicate code or XMLID, foreign/unadmitted configuration namespace; model_id references, registry dispatch, installation and active scheduling always unresolved

source_admission.required_owner_work: Reuse native FileFacts/CollectedFile typed syntax and shared resolver/StructuralIndex/SQLSnapshot owners. Capture bounded decorator expressions/arguments and class/local-method/metadata ownership while the existing tree lives; strict handoff accounting and versioning in serial/queue. Admit XML only as bounded explicit configuration through the same inventory/transaction, with typed cron-source/value records; no second Python source parser/scan/resolver/graph, no new dependency or executing manifest/XML code.

row_contract.source_declaration: one distinct framework row per selected source annotation/method/configuration declaration; target kind must remain method_declaration or configuration_value as frozen
row_contract.unknown: one explicit source-backed framework_boundary per rejected relevant API/model/configuration/dispatch candidate; zero targets, reason/partial-role/source evidence; no asserted qualified framework identity
row_contract.lookalikes: no framework declaration or boundary without a relevant imported API/base/configuration witness
row_contract.query: same native budget/cursor owner; count each declaration and empty-target boundary row in examined work, edges and bytes; preserve repeated occurrences and held snapshot identity; no runtime/call graph traversal

ceilings: Private draft source preparation only; independent source admission and T018 acceptance required before T019 runtime work.

Source annotation/local method/configuration bindings do not prove active routes, installed registry classes, XMLID records, cron activation, scheduling, database effects, workflow order, deployment or full business completeness.
No name-based model_/method joins, cross-service joins, arbitrary packaging/facades, decorator execution, inherited dispatch, safe_eval or recordset target inference.
XML configuration facts require bounded shared-owner support; current producer support and task tests have not been claimed.
